summary: Sleep Number Corp filed an 8-K on April 27, 2026, disclosing a Forbearance Agreement and Thirteenth Amendment to its credit agreement with U.S. Bank. The amendment adds a $25 million term loan (2026 Term Loan) at SOFR + 8.00%, maturing June 30, 2026, with a $5 million amortization due June 1, 2026. Lenders will forbear from exercising remedies on specified defaults. The company must achieve milestones to consummate a strategic transaction designed to maximize enterprise value and pay off obligations. Cash interest is payable monthly. Mandatory prepayments apply from asset sales, equity/debt issuances, or insurance proceeds. Minimum liquidity covenant is suspended from April 27 until end of first week after July 1, 2026. What to watch: execution of the strategic transaction and ability to refinance or restructure debt by June 30 term loan maturity.
